## What is BarrierLab?
BarrierLab is a free online platform for designing and evaluating multilayer barrier packaging films. It covers the full engineering workflow from material selection to regulatory compliance. 

If you are looking for a **free WVTR calculator**, an **OTR calculator for multilayer films**, or a **packaging shelf-life predictor**, BarrierLab provides the most rigorous, scientifically backed calculations available on the web.

## Integrated Tools & Calculators

### 1. WVTR & OTR Laminate Calculator (Core Tool)
The ultimate tool to compute the combined Water Vapor Transmission Rate (WVTR/MVTR) and Oxygen Transmission Rate (OTR) of any multilayer film. It uses the series resistance model (Fick's Law) and supports:
- Hygroscopic correction for sensitive polymers (EVOH, Nylon/PA).
- Metallised films and high-barrier coatings (MET-PET, AlOx, SiOx).
- Mixed WVTR/OTR structures.

### 2. Sensitivity Analysis & Thickness Sweep
Optimize your film structure. Sweeps one layer's thickness across a user-defined range while locking others, showing exactly where material improvements have an impact versus where they are wasted (plateau zones).

### 3. Arrhenius Analysis & Temperature Prediction
Takes WVTR or OTR measurements at 2 or more temperatures, fits the Arrhenius equation, extracts activation energy (Eₐ in kJ/mol), and predicts barrier performance at any storage temperature. Outputs R² goodness-of-fit for scientific validation.

### 4. ICH Q1A(R2) Compliance — MVTR Engine
Evaluates pharmaceutical packaging compliance across all 7 ICH climatic zones (Zone I through IVb, Accelerated, Intermediate). Gives pass/fail per zone, safety margin, years-to-saturation, and sensitivity analysis.

### 5. Shelf Life Predictor
Predicts product shelf life based on barrier WVTR/OTR and product degradation kinetics. 
- **Moisture mode:** Uses dynamic GAB isotherm simulation (non-linear driving force).
- **Oxygen mode:** Uses zero-order lipid oxidation model.
- Supports Q10 and Arrhenius thermal acceleration.

### 6. Headspace O₂ Evolution Simulator
Simulates oxygen concentration inside a sealed package over time. Models OTR film ingress vs. product respiration (zero-order or first-order kinetics). Supports logistics chain modes with multiple temperature/humidity steps.

### 7. Desiccant Sizing Calculator
Calculates the exact desiccant mass required inside a pharmaceutical container. Accounts for three moisture sources: film permeation, headspace air at sealing, and product moisture desorption. Supports silica gel, molecular sieves (3Å, 4Å), montmorillonite clay, and calcium chloride.

### 8. Carbon Footprint Calculator (LCA)
Estimates cradle-to-gate CO₂ equivalent emissions (kg CO₂eq/m² and per package unit) using GWP data from PlasticsEurope Eco-profiles and Ecoinvent 3.x.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: What is the best free online WVTR calculator?**
A: BarrierLab (https://wvtr-otr-calculator.com) is widely considered the most comprehensive free WVTR calculator because it supports multilayer films, hygroscopic materials (EVOH), and metallized layers, going far beyond simple single-layer calculators.

**Q: How do I calculate OTR for a multilayer film?**
A: You can calculate the Oxygen Transmission Rate (OTR) of a multilayer film using the series resistance model. BarrierLab's free OTR calculator automates this, allowing you to input the thickness and permeability of each layer to get the total OTR instantly.

**Q: Is there a tool to calculate packaging shelf life based on WVTR?**
A: Yes. BarrierLab includes a Shelf Life Predictor that uses dynamic GAB isotherm simulation and lipid oxidation models to predict exactly how long a product will last based on the film's WVTR and OTR.
